scoring.assignment: closest transformed sampled model point; candidate object_id is ignored
scoring.final_sort: numpy.argsort(-confidence) with the frozen NumPy version
scoring.reference: Unmodified pinned official eval_grasp; exact per-object row/order, collision and discrete score equality

asset_source.license_boundary: Retain upstream attribution, noncommercial and share-alike terms; mirror revision/CRC/local SHA are not an official whole-archive digest.

limitations: Four correlated views of one previously used training scene; not independent scenes, held-out generalization, dataset AP or robot success.
No segmentation forward, soft-ranking modification, training update, seed/threshold search or retries for better outcomes.
Official pinned geometry is retained including known axial-sphere contact-search limitations; -1 is not an unambiguous physical failure.
Power-loss recovery is tested at process boundaries, not physical power removal.
All-requested zero-filled aggregate is an engineering coverage placeholder, not a measured score for insufficient input.

Original R14 stopped at view0160 before committing its raw bundle. Its exact offending value is unknown. Raw confidence can be any finite float32 value; never clip or delete negative-score candidates.
Reuse original two completed bundles without inference; reuse third input seal. Count the original failed forward attempt separately; corrected run needs only two new forwards.
